fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.schema_description: Site where the SpX overlay will be created.

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). The UI value is 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when the row has location_type (location-options.ts:21-36).

fields.query_param_normalization: Once locations load, the value is resolved by encoded value, id, or display name. It is replaced only while the current value is empty or still equals the raw query, and an unresolvable value becomes '' (spx-overlay-creation-workflow-form.tsx:97-112).
client_only_validation: Trimmed min 1 'Site is required' (:44); the schema has no minLength
fields.submit_transform: The encoded option is decoded: site = option id, or the raw value if no option matches. The location type is emitted as site_type (:137-140).

fields.name: overlay_id
fields.label: Overlay ID
fields.schema_description: Unique identifier for the SpX overlay. Used as an idempotency key — re-running with the same ID returns existing VRFs without creating new ones.

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant
fields.schema_description: Tenant that will own the SpX overlay.

options.notes: useTenants (useTenants.ts:31-49) lists all tenants without managed_only, unlike the useEnvData tenant list. Searchable; the contiguous-text filter and exact-match ranking are covered by spxOverlayCreationForm.spec.ts:102-127.

fields.query_param_normalization: useSyncSelectFromQuery (useSyncSelectFromQuery.ts:38-68): after options load, the value is kept if it equals an option value, otherwise it becomes ''. Each distinct query value is synced once.

fields.name: namespace_tag
fields.label: Namespace Tag
fields.schema_description: Tag identifying the namespace used for allocation.

options.notes: useNamespaceTags(selectedSite) (useNamespaceTags.ts:31-58): location and location_type are split from the encoded site value, and with no site it fetches unfiltered (all tags). Once options load, a current value not among them is cleared to '' with validation (spx-overlay-creation-workflow-form.tsx:123-133).

fields.query_param_normalization: namespace_tag, falling back to the alias 'namespace', falling back to 'spectrumx' (:63-66). The specs use the alias '&namespace=' (spxOverlayCreationForm.spec.ts:138). The value is cleared if it is not in the loaded options.
client_only_validation: Value must exist in the loaded namespace-tag options or it is cleared (:123-133)

fields.name: rd_min
fields.label: RD Min
fields.schema_description: Lower bound of the route-distinguisher allocation range (0–65535). The first available RD in [rd_min, rd_max] is allocated.
fields.query_param_normalization: Number(value) || 60000, so '0', empty and non-numeric values all fall back to the default (:67).
client_only_validation: rd_min < rd_max, error reported on rd_min: 'RD Min must be less than RD Max' (:51-54)
An empty input yields NaN, which fails z.number()
fields.submit_transform: valueAsNumber from the number input (formfield.tsx:106-112), sent as a JSON number.

fields.name: rd_max
fields.label: RD Max
fields.schema_description: Upper bound of the route-distinguisher allocation range (0–65535). Must be greater than rd_min.
fields.query_param_normalization: Number(value) || 65000, so '0', empty and non-numeric values all fall back to the default (:68).
fields.submit_transform: valueAsNumber, sent as a JSON number.

fields.name: site_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the site identifier.
fields.widget_today: none (derived from the selected site option)
fields.submit_transform: location.locationType (:140). The key is omitted when undefined.

payload_transform: onSubmit (spx-overlay-creation-workflow-form.tsx:135-158) builds {site: option?.id ?? data.site, site_type: option?.locationType, overlay_id, tenant, namespace_tag, rd_min, rd_max} and POSTs it to /v1/workflow/ngc/spx_overlay_creation. The key order matches the model declaration order, and undefined site_type is dropped by JSON.stringify.
discrepancies: The RD range 0–65535 and rd_min < rd_max are enforced only on the client. The schema states them in description text only (spx_overlay.py:144-153), with no ge/le bounds or model validator.
namespace_tag is optional in the schema (default 'spectrumx') but required in the UI. The UI also clears it when it is not in the site's namespace-tag options.
Tenant options here are all tenants (useTenants), while the other forms use managed_only tenants (useEnvData).
A query value of rd_min=0 or rd_max=0 silently becomes the default.
The UI requires site to be non-empty; the schema has no minLength (LocationReference rejects empty values only at API reference resolution).
Changing site does not clear tenant or overlay_id; only namespace_tag can change, through option revalidation.
contract_gaps: query_param takes a single name, but namespace_tag accepts 'namespace_tag' or the alias 'namespace', which is the alias the specs use.
There is no cross-field validation hint for rd_min < rd_max, and numeric bounds exist only in client code (adding them to the schema would change the schema, which is out of scope).
Renderer behaviour is unspecified for a default or prefilled select value that is absent from the loaded async options (here it is cleared).
namespace_tag depends_on needs location and location_type derived from the encoded site option, not a sibling field's raw value.

The namespace-tag option source is fetched even when its dependency is empty, returning all tags, whereas the overlay sources are disabled until a site is selected. The contract does not say which behaviour applies.
Query-param number parsing (falsy values fall back to the default) is unspecified.
